title: 017 · Map #1: the biggest NDA maths chapter now (Probability) + all of it on one map (predict-first, white, drive)

captions.instagram:
NDA Maths · Probability. Which chapter gets the most NDA maths questions now? A Matrices · B Probability · C Trig 👇

B. In the last 3 papers (NDA-2 2025, NDA-1 2026, NDA-2 2026) Probability had 14, 13 and 14 questions: 41 of 360, the most of any chapter (Matrices 31, Trig 20).
And 90 of the 176 Probability PYQs since 2017 are just counting: favourable ÷ total.

The whole chapter on one map: counting · 1 − P(A) for "at least one" · A or B · exclusive · independent · given B · Bayes · binomial.
Trap: exclusive is NOT independent. If A and B can't happen together, P(A∩B) = 0, but P(A)·P(B) isn't 0.

Screenshot the map 📌 Follow @lws.pune for one NDA maths idea every day.
